description: A Flutter widget representing a splash/routing screen that determines the next screen based on user preferences and navigates accordingly. It displays a centered icon, app name, progress bar, and a footer message.

classes.name: SecondScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that serves as a splash or routing screen after app launch, deciding which screen to display next based on stored preferences.

classes.name: _SecondScreenState
classes.description: State class for SecondScreen handling initialization and navigation logic after a short delay.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Overrides the initState method to initialize the state and start the delayed routing process.

methods.name: _routeAfterDelay
methods.description: Awaits a 1-second delay, retrieves preference flags, determines the next screen, and navigates to it.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the splash screen, including icon, text, progress indicator, and footer.
